groups.name: Warm cream/off-white page background
groups.definition: Is the page's main background a warm cream or off-white tone rather than pure white or black?

groups.name: Warm beige band separating sections
groups.definition: Does a section use a warm off-white or beige background band to separate it from white areas?

groups.name: Alternating tinted section background bands
groups.definition: Do full-width sections alternate between two or more background colors (e.g., white, cream, pale tint, dark) to separate content bands?

groups.name: Dark theme page background
groups.definition: Is the page background dark (near-black or dark navy) with light text?

groups.name: Dark footer band
groups.definition: Is the footer a very dark (charcoal or navy) band with light text?

groups.name: Dark top announcement or utility bar
groups.definition: Is there a dark top announcement or utility bar above the header?

groups.name: Dark navy bands for secondary content
groups.definition: Are dark navy bands used to anchor sections like hero, top bar or content blocks alongside light panels?

groups.name: Light band interrupting dark page
groups.definition: Does a light-colored band interrupt a dark page to hold content such as a logo strip?

groups.name: Clean white header band
groups.definition: Is the header band a clean white background?

groups.name: Near-black or charcoal body text
groups.definition: Is body text a near-black or dark charcoal color rather than pure black?

groups.name: Navy-tinted dark body text
groups.definition: Is body text a dark navy or blue-tinted slate rather than neutral gray or black?

groups.name: Green-tinted dark body text
groups.definition: Is body text a dark green-tinted color rather than neutral gray?

groups.name: Dark brown or rust or purple-slate text
groups.definition: Is body text a warm brown, rust or slate-purple tone?

groups.name: Two-tone text on dark (white headings, muted body)
groups.definition: On a dark background, are headings white and supporting copy a muted grey or blue-grey tone?

groups.name: Single orange accent color
groups.definition: Is a single orange or burnt-orange accent used for buttons, links, labels and badges?

groups.name: Single red accent color
groups.definition: Is a single red, crimson or rust-red accent used for links, buttons and CTAs?

groups.name: Single cyan or teal accent color
groups.definition: Is a single bright cyan, teal or mint accent used for buttons, links and highlights?

groups.name: Pink or magenta accent
groups.definition: Is a hot pink, crimson-magenta or vivid magenta used as an accent?

groups.name: Blue-based palette with dark navy
groups.definition: Is the palette built on navy and blue tones with light blue tints and accents?

groups.name: Green-based palette
groups.definition: Is the palette built on green tones with mint or sage tints?

groups.name: Earthy or warm multi-color palette
groups.definition: Does the palette mix earthy or warm accent colors (teal, sage, tan, orange, peach) with warm off-white panels?

groups.name: Warm beige-gray neutral borders and fills
groups.definition: Are borders and fills a muted warm beige-gray alongside white cards?

groups.name: Gray alert strip with white button
groups.definition: Is there a solid mid-gray band with white text and a white button with colored text?

groups.name: Gradient hero background
groups.definition: Is the hero background a gradient rather than a flat color?
